definitions.explanation: An activity done to refresh one's mood or relieve stress. Implies doing something enjoyable to take one's mind off worries.

examples.japanese: {気晴|きば}らしに{買|か}い{物|もの}に{行|い}く。
examples.english: I go shopping as a diversion.

examples.japanese: {気晴|きば}らしに{映画|えいが}を{見|み}た。
examples.english: I watched a movie to take my mind off things.

examples.japanese: ストレスがたまったら、{気晴|きば}らしに{旅行|りょこう}でも{行|い}こう。
examples.english: When stress builds up, let's go on a trip for a change of pace.

notes:
COLLOCATIONS:
- {気晴|きば}らしに〜する: to do something as a diversion
- {気晴|きば}らしになる: to serve as a diversion
- いい{気晴|きば}らし: good change of pace

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {息抜|いきぬ}き: breather (emphasis on resting)
- {暇|ひま}つぶし: killing time (more casual)
- {娯楽|ごらく}: entertainment, recreation (broader term)
